Personality: Epasnactos, a prominent figure of the Salassi, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Epasnactos owes allegiance to the Roman Provincial Command, hailing from the noble house of Salassi. Historical Record: Son of Seuvo and Sacrovira, of the Salassi, a Celtic house of the Cisalpine Gauls. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
